info.name: Ballpoint API
info.description:
Pre-built requests for the Ballpoint Marketing direct mail API. Aligned to API_KIT v1.7.43 and OpenAPI 3.1.0. Import the matching environment to set base_url and partner_key. Three environments are provided:
- Ballpoint Staging: PropStream integration testing (staging-api host; paste your staging pk_test key).
- Ballpoint Sandbox: internal test key on api.ballpointmarketing.com (no real mail).
- Ballpoint Production: future go-live with a pk_live key.

SANDBOX MODEL: a pk_test_ key against the production host creates orders but NO real mail is printed or sent.

TIERS:
- Tier A (Safe reads and preview): read-only + preview; A1 runs cold, A2 needs a seeded order_id/campaign_id (auto-skips if unseeded). Newman smoke target: folder 'A1 - No setup required'.
- Tier B (Manual partner flows): creates data; run manually.
- Tier C (Destructive and gated - manual only): cancel/reschedule/confirm-payment/recipient edits/opt-out toggles. Never bulk-run. Tolerant tests.

Coverage is static/source-reviewed, not runtime-verified.

request.description: Liveness check. No authentication required. The documented public health endpoint.
Safe read used automatically by the iframe. Returns boolean-only flags and a 60-second private cache TTL.
Full pricing catalog (tenth-cents). Divide unit_price_tcents by 10000 for dollars per piece.
Pricing rows for a single product_type (e.g. 4x6_printed).

Preview cost WITHOUT creating an order (single-order/pre-submission UX). partner_cost_total_tcents is raw wholesale tenth-cent math and may contain a fractional cent; total_tcents/total_dollars are partner-display only. For payment-gated submissions, use the campaign-level 'Preview campaign cost (payment-gate)' request below and read partner_debit_cents / campaign_partner_debit_cents for the exact successful-confirmation cents.

Campaign-level preview for payment-gate flows. Wait until every selected ballpointOrderId is non-null, upload the matching recipients to every selected order, and verify every selected upload reports ready=true with piece_count>0 before calling. A/B variants require recipient-disjoint slices (full name + mailing address). Prices exactly the caller-selected set of order IDs (any subset of one campaign; the endpoint does not compute billing windows). After preview, call /confirm-payment only for response rows where excluded_from_totals=false, and re-preview after any order/recipient edit. Returns per-order raw wholesale tcents (partner_cost_total_tcents) plus the exact whole-cent /confirm-payment ledger result: per-order partner_debit_cents (ceil for stripe/manual, 0 for billing_mode=none, null for excluded orders) and campaign_partner_debit_cents (sum of the per-order values). campaign_partner_cost_total_tcents remains the raw chargeable-now tcents sum (excludes already-confirmed/cancelled/failed drops); use campaign_partner_debit_cents as the exact ledger result. Replaces the legacy pattern of looping POST /v1/billing/orders/preview once per drop. Partner-only (X-Partner-Key); X-API-Key is rejected with 401. Returns 409 PAYMENT_GATE_NOT_ACTIVE on non-gated accounts and 409 INVALID_PIECE_COUNT when any persisted order has zero pieces. Auto-skips in Newman if {{ballpoint_order_id}} is unseeded.

request.description: Paginated partner-scoped order list with computed sla_status. Supports status, product_type, sla, search, list_id, external_user_id filters (AND).
Operational health snapshot scoped to your account: api_status, last_error, rate_limit, daily_piece_cap, plus build + contractVersions (v1.6.7+).

Log-only client-error telemetry intake. Called AUTOMATICALLY by the embedded iframe (window.onerror / unhandledrejection) - partners do NOT need to integrate it. Documented here because it is partner-key authenticated and requests will appear in partner-side network monitoring. Response is 204 with an empty body on success; 413/422/429 error responses have empty bodies by design (401 returns the standard auth error envelope). Caps: 4096-byte request body, 60 requests/minute per partner key, per-field length caps (name<=50, message<=220, source<=300, pageId<=40, buildId<=64, contractVersions<=6 keys/20 chars). PII is scrubbed client-side by the iframe before send.

Log-only iframe funnel telemetry prepared for local and staging validation. Called AUTOMATICALLY by the embedded iframe; partners do NOT need to integrate it. One event is sent per POST with X-Partner-Key and X-External-User-ID. The 204 response has an empty body; 413/422/429 error responses are also empty, while 401 uses the standard auth error envelope. The endpoint-specific ceiling is 1,000 attempts with valid partner and user context per 60 seconds for each account/source/external-account tuple, enforced per API process; its 429 has no general rate-limit headers or Retry-After. The closed body is capped at 2048 bytes and contains no account/tenant/user identity, recipient PII, or typed copy. submit_clicked may repeat when payment is reopened; campaign_submitted_confirmed is emitted only after payment success; drop-off is derived from the last received event. Inclusion in this collection does not assert staging runtime deployment or production availability.

item.name: Tier B - Manual partner flows
item.description: Creates data. Run manually; not part of the smoke subset.

request.description: Create a postcard order (billing format). Idempotency-Key is REQUIRED and a FRESH {{$guid}} is generated each send - do not reuse a stale key. Returns 202. Saves order_id to the environment.
Create a letter order (billing format). Letters REQUIRE envelope_style; postcards reject it. color_letter supports only plain_white. Returns 202.

Create an order in the partner/iframe format (PartnerOrderCreateRequest). postage_type selects first_class, standard, or presort and is persisted for pricing; omitted legacy requests default to first_class. For product_type color_letter, canvas_json.front is accepted without back because the V1 insert is one-sided and the V1 order limit is 500 pieces; two-sided canvas products continue sending both front and back. Color Letter canvas_json is limited to 20 MiB, depth 50, 10,000 JSON nodes, and 1,000 Fabric objects; embedded images are limited to 14 MiB of base64 PNG/JPEG/WebP data, and remote images must use approved Ballpoint asset paths or the PropStream /direct-mail/ prefix. Other hosts and tokenized image URLs are rejected. Existing two-sided product request validation is unchanged. sender.zip accepts 5 digits, 9 digits, or ZIP+4; sender.phone accepts 10 digits or 11 beginning with 1 plus standard formatting. Invalid non-empty sender contact values return 422 before order creation. Orders sharing a list_id are stitched into one Ballpoint campaign. Returns 200; the order id is under 'id' (not 'order_id'). Response shape is not strictly modeled - capture is tolerant.

exec: // Informational, non-failing: capture the order id under whichever key is present.

item.name: Upload recipients - initial (replace; requires seeded order_id)

request.description: Initial recipient upload for an order. PropStream flow: create the order first (with piece_count), then upload addresses here. append=false (default) REPLACES all existing recipients (idempotent re-upload); append=true APPENDS (chunked uploads). Max 10,000 recipients/request. Required per recipient: address, city, state (2-letter), zip (5 or 5+4); at least one of first_name/last_name (rows missing both are soft-rejected into rejected_details - partial acceptance). placeHolders (camelCase) carries V1 Owner/Property merge values plus optional message-only PropertyValue. In canvas-backed designs, handwritten aliases resolve as {first_name} from first_name, {property_address} from PropertyStreet, {city} from PropertyCity, and {property_value} from PropertyValue; missing property data prints blank and never falls back to the delivery address. The message field alone does not synthesize a missing canvas for legacy catalog products. Allowed order statuses: scheduled, pending_payment, accepted, prep. Distinct from Edit Leads (PATCH /recipients), which resizes piece_count + reprices on gated drops. Requires a seeded order_id in an uploadable status; tolerant test.

item.name: Tier C - Destructive and gated - manual only
item.description: Mutating or payment-gated. Run manually one at a time against an order you own. Excluded from any Newman run. Tolerant tests.

request.description: DESTRUCTIVE. Canonical partner cancellation endpoint. Allowed only before production prep (scheduled, pending_payment, payment_failed, or accepted). Emits order.status_changed and order.drop_cancelled on a successful transition. Refund behavior depends on billing mode. Manual only - excluded from smoke runs.

STATE-CHANGE. Updates the scheduled mail date in place (same order_id). Allowed only when production_status=scheduled AND payment_confirmed=false. Recomputes scheduled_production_date from the product SLA. new_mail_date is auto-set ~45 days ahead by the collection pre-request. Manual only.

GATED, server-to-server ONLY (never from a browser - exposes the key). Gated accounts only (requires_payment_confirmation=TRUE). This call is authoritative for Ballpoint billing and production state and is separate from the browser payment_result UX signal; neither replaces the other. v1.7.27: partner key (full tenant identity) or internal ops key required - same-account live/test Bearer tokens get 401 PARTNER_KEY_REQUIRED; a first status:success is accepted only from scheduled/pending_payment/accepted unconfirmed states, otherwise 409 ORDER_NOT_CHARGEABLE with no debit. Upload and validate recipients first, then refetch POST /v1/billing/campaigns/preview before collecting payment. status:success applies the account billing policy (stripe debits balance; manual records usage; none records no charge/usage) and advances pending_payment -> accepted. A persisted piece_count<=0 returns 409 INVALID_PIECE_COUNT before any debit or payment-state mutation. Set order_id and transaction_id in your environment before sending. Tolerant test. Manual only.

GATED, server-to-server only. This call is authoritative for Ballpoint billing and production state and is separate from the browser payment_result UX signal; neither replaces the other. status:failed moves the order to payment_failed (terminal); no balance debit. Replaying the opposite status returns 409. Set order_id and transaction_id in your environment before sending. Tolerant test. Manual only.

GATED. Replaces all recipients on the order, resizes piece_count, and reprices. Gated accounts only; order status must be scheduled or pending_payment and payment_confirmed=false. Does not debit. Tolerant test. Manual only.

GATED. Campaign-level delta add/remove across all editable drops (status scheduled/pending_payment, payment_confirmed=false). Locked drops are skipped and reported. Gated accounts only. Tolerant test. Manual only.

STATE-CHANGE. Persists tenant-wide normalized-address suppression, including before tracking exists. The public key remains recipient_address + recipient_city + recipient_state + ZIP5; there is no separate address2 input in v1.7.35. Set the four recipient address variables from a test search result before sending; they are intentionally blank in every environment. rows_affected counts only legacy piece_tracking flags and may be 0 on success. An unknown address returns 404 RECIPIENT_NOT_FOUND without mutation. Does not filter future partner recipient uploads. Manual only - excluded from smoke runs.
